tokens.name: --og-bg
tokens.use: All screen backgrounds; tab bar; page gutters

tokens.name: --og-raised
tokens.use: Subtle grouped content and overlay transitions

tokens.name: --og-surface
tokens.use: Sheets, menus, secondary buttons

tokens.name: --og-surface-2
tokens.use: Input backgrounds, segments, alerts, inactive heatmap cells

tokens.name: --og-line
tokens.use: Flat row dividers and section separators

tokens.name: --og-line-strong
tokens.use: Grouping boundaries and inactive chart lines

tokens.name: --og-fg
tokens.use: Names, logged numbers, calorie totals and chart targets

tokens.name: --og-fg2
tokens.use: Dates, units, labels, inactive tabs and essential supporting copy

tokens.name: --og-fg3
tokens.use: Nonessential hints and visible control boundaries; use fg2 for small readable labels

tokens.name: --og-disabled
tokens.use: Unavailable controls only; never essential information

tokens.name: --og-on-action
tokens.use: White labels on the action-fill blue, matching accent

tokens.name: --og-on-color
tokens.use: Dark text on cyan, gold, green or orange fills when required

tokens.name: --og-accent
tokens.use: Actions, selected tabs, focus rings, logo plates, completion, strength trends and protein

tokens.name: --og-action-fill
tokens.use: Primary button and selected calendar fills with white text

tokens.name: --og-action-hover
tokens.use: Pointer hover on filled primary buttons; keep white labels

tokens.name: --og-action-pressed
tokens.use: Pressed primary buttons; keep white labels

tokens.name: --og-cyan
tokens.use: Carbohydrate bars, stacked charts, legends and labels

tokens.name: --og-gold
tokens.use: Fat bars, stacked charts, legends and labels; not a warning color

tokens.name: --og-tip
tokens.use: Up, records, goals ready, live session indicator, climbing trend

tokens.name: --og-warn
tokens.use: Missed days, drop sets, backup due, slipping, insufficient data and calorie overage

tokens.name: --og-danger
tokens.use: Delete, validation errors, downward workout comparisons and unlikely goal verdicts

tokens.name: --og-danger-fill
tokens.use: Destructive filled buttons with white labels; red text uses danger instead

tokens.name: --og-macro-protein
tokens.use: Stable nutrition identity; separate semantic alias

tokens.name: --og-macro-carbs
tokens.use: Stable nutrition identity; separate semantic alias

tokens.name: --og-macro-fat
tokens.use: Stable nutrition identity; separate semantic alias

tokens.name: --og-focus
tokens.use: 2px visible focus ring, 2px offset; use white around filled primary buttons

tokens.name: --og-control-stroke
tokens.use: Essential input and control outlines; hairlines are not sufficient

tokens.name: --og-cal-today
tokens.use: White outline when unselected; selected date uses action-fill

tokens.name: --og-cal-missed
tokens.use: Orange outline, paired with missed-day text

tokens.name: --og-cal-changed
tokens.use: Dashed neutral outline for one-off plan changes

tokens.name: --og-chart-grid
tokens.use: Thin, low-emphasis chart scaffolding

tokens.name: --og-chart-dot
tokens.use: Historic observations and unloaded plate-pad details

tokens.name: --og-bar
tokens.use: Earlier periods in single-series charts; latest period uses accent

tokens.name: --og-logo-bar
tokens.use: Neutral barbell shaft; plates use accent

tokens.name: --og-kp-bg
tokens.use: Numeric keypad and plate-pad background

tokens.name: --og-key
tokens.use: Numeric keys; white labels

tokens.name: --og-key-fn
tokens.use: Keypad functions, backspace and mode keys

tokens.name: --og-swipe
tokens.use: Neutral gesture reveal; visible alternate action remains available

tokens.name: --og-swipe-armed
tokens.use: Active gesture threshold; white labels

tokens.name: --og-done
tokens.use: Subtle blue completed-row and resume-bar fill

tokens.name: --og-input-edit
tokens.use: Editing and suggested-weight field fill

tokens.name: --og-accent-soft
tokens.use: Subtle selection, chart band and new-comparison badge

tokens.name: --og-effort
tokens.use: Logged effort badge on a completed set

tokens.name: --og-effort-glow
tokens.use: Existing effort badge focus glow only

tokens.name: --og-success-soft
tokens.use: Record and positive-comparison badge fill

tokens.name: --og-danger-soft
tokens.use: Negative-comparison badge fill

tokens.name: --og-plan-code
tokens.use: Calendar routine code brighter than its unselected date

tokens.name: --og-scrim
tokens.use: Sheet, hold-menu and alert backdrops

tokens.name: --og-badge-shadow
tokens.use: Existing floating effort badge only; no general card shadows
